# Daniel Ari Friedman, PhD

I study how systems make sense of the world, from [harvester ant colonies](https://danielarifriedman.com/domain-entomology.html) to [Active Inference models](https://danielarifriedman.com/domain-active-inference.html) and [information ecosystems](https://danielarifriedman.com/domain-cognitive-security.html). I build open-source research tools, teach biology, and draw in pen and ink.

[Research website](https://danielarifriedman.com/) · [Search](https://danielarifriedman.com/search.html) · [Publications](https://danielarifriedman.com/publications.html) · [Software](https://danielarifriedman.com/software.html) · [CV](https://danielarifriedman.com/resume/resume.pdf)

[Research domains](#research-domains) · [Featured projects](#featured-projects) · [Interactive tools](#interactive-tools) · [Reading trails](#reading-trails) · [Teaching and media](#teaching-and-media) · [Art](#art) · [Sources and reuse](#sources-and-reuse)

## Start exploring

- [Start here](https://danielarifriedman.com/start-here.html) offers guided routes into the research, writing, and tools.
- [Data catalog](https://danielarifriedman.com/catalog.html) describes the public datasets, and [exports](https://danielarifriedman.com/exports.html) links to the files for citation managers and analysis.
- [Cite and verify](https://danielarifriedman.com/cite-verify.html) connects citations, source evidence, and version-specific records.

The public website brings together the bibliography, software, research media,
and art. The [paper folders](https://github.com/docxology/docxology/tree/main/papers/) retain per-work sources and documentation.
The [repository manuscript](https://github.com/docxology/docxology/blob/main/docs/manuscript/README.md) explains how the index is
built and checked.

## Interactive tools

| Try it | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| [Bayesian update](https://danielarifriedman.com/lab.html#bayes) | Change the prior and compare how positive and negative observations move the posterior. |
| [Reinforced urn](https://danielarifriedman.com/lab.html#urn) | Change the starting mix, draw tokens, and compare how repeated reinforcement shapes the outcome. |
| [Research map](https://danielarifriedman.com/research-map.html?node=work%3AFriedman2026CrossTalkPage239) | Start at the CrossTalk study and follow its connections to related works, contributors, and software. |
| [Publication filters](https://danielarifriedman.com/publications.html?doi=1&docs=1) | Start with works that have both a DOI and paper documentation. Refine the results by year, type, or domain. |
| [Reading list](https://danielarifriedman.com/collections.html#v=1&title=Research%20methods&works=Friedman2026CrossTalkPage239%2CFriedman2026PyCIProExactGeometry240) | Open a two-paper preview, reorder or add works, and export BibTeX or RIS. |
| [Catalog search](https://danielarifriedman.com/search.html?q=Active%20Inference) | Search works, software, site pages, people, organizations, and evidence from one place. |

## Reading trails

| Trail | Route |
| --- | --- |
| [From probability to Active Inference](https://danielarifriedman.com/trails.html#active-inference-foundations) | Start with a [Bayesian update](https://danielarifriedman.com/lab.html#bayes), read the [Free Energy Principle literature analysis](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2022FreeEnergyPrincipleActive073.html), then explore [Generalized Notation Notation](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2023GeneralizedNotationNotationActive056.html). |
| [Ants, reinforcement, and collective behavior](https://danielarifriedman.com/trails.html#ants-and-collectives) | Try the [reinforced urn](https://danielarifriedman.com/lab.html#urn), then read how [forager hydration](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2019PhysiologyForagerHydrationVariation095.html) and [dopamine](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2018RoleDopamineCollectiveRegulation100.html) affect ant foraging. |
| [Information commons and cognitive security](https://danielarifriedman.com/trails.html#cognitive-security) | Move from [narrative ecosystems](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2021NarrativeInformationEcosystemsConflict079.html) to the [design of an information commons](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2022StructuringInformationCommonsOpen071.html). |
| [From research teams to reproducible artifacts](https://danielarifriedman.com/trails.html#reproducible-research) | Read the [research template paper](https://danielarifriedman.com/works/Friedman2026TemplateApproachReproducibleGenerative001.html), then find the underlying artifacts in the [data catalog](https://danielarifriedman.com/catalog.html). |
